title: E-GRV-0112: a lump accreted under the clock criterion forms its horizon without a slip but freezes more history into...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0112 in the gravity arena: a lump accreted under the clock criterion forms its horizon without a slip but freezes more history into it, fail on G2 and G3: E-GRV-0109's M = 1600 lump built one unit every 2 beats with the horizon joined where the found depth exceeds the reference's by 3/2 runs 4,223 beats with 0 wraps (E-GRV-0109's order under the same criterion 61, untorn 9,852), curl 0, energy to 3e-9 and every event reversed bit for bit, the husk's step never above 1.11; the horizon forms at unit 589 (statics 604) and grows to 761 docks at radius 5.83, matching the statics except 0.55 dock ahead at M = 800 (gate 0.5); but docks tear while the lump fills and hold their steps (up to 1.11), so the settled force is 36 percent off the placed lump's at r = 8 .. 11 (E-GRV-0109: 22) and 407 of 894 horizon verticals carry flux back up, 761 units returning through the bulk outside the horizon.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
